output.summary: KEP-630 proposed the AWS EBS CSI Driver as a standalone, out-of-tree CSI plugin offering the same features as the in-tree EBS plugin. The KEP remained in provisional status; the tracking issue was closed in August 2019 because CSI drivers are tracked out of tree by storage providers.
output.rationale:
The driver was meant to live outside the Kubernetes core, gaining modularity and reach beyond Kubernetes (e.g., ECS). Release-team tracking was questioned because CSI drivers ship outside k/k, so the release team declined to track it for v1.14. The issue was closed in August 2019 with the note that CSI drivers are tracked out of tree by storage providers.</persistence_rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">The sources do not state a formal KEP rejection. The issue was closed because CSI drivers are tracked out of tree by storage providers, and the KEP was never moved past provisional in the record given.

alternatives.option: Track the driver as a Kubernetes core enhancement for release milestones (v1.14 and later)
alternatives.why_not: Maintainers argued CSI drivers should not be tracked as part of the Kubernetes core release, since the point of CSI was to decouple plugin development from core Kubernetes.

alternatives.option: Move the enhancement issue out of the enhancements repo to another location
alternatives.why_not: Suggested by saad-ali as an alternative to closing, but the sources show the issue was closed instead.

alternatives.option: Track the release via the Kubernetes blog or release notes for out-of-tree releases
alternatives.why_not: spiffxp said release notes should not cover out-of-tree code, and suggested the blog as the place for such updates, not as a tracked enhancement.

evidence.quote: I don't think CSI drivers should be tracked as part of the Kubernetes core release. The whole point of CSI was to decouple plugin development from the development of core Kubernetes.
I agree with @saad-ali the release team shouldn't track this for v1.14.
/close since csi drivers are tracked out of tree by storage providers
Similar to CNI plugins, AWS EBS CSI driver will be a stand alone plugin that lives out-of-tree of kubernetes.
